note: [LLM critic, high conf] Stormboyz declare a 17% charge at a 16 wound Battlewagon. The Stormboyz cannot hurt it much and would be left alone deep in enemy lines. Fix: Compute melee damage against the target's real toughness, save and wounds. Pay the tie_up_shooter bonus only when the expected damage or the lock time is meaningful. Apply a minimum charge-chance cutoff, for example 25%, unless the target is high value and the damage is real. Add a penalty for ending the charge far from friendly support inside enemy threat range.
